chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassash, from Dawud al-Hammarr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), similar to it.
And he (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who frequently remembers Allah, Allah will shade him in His Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of frequently remembering Allah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of al-Kulayni in *Al-Kafi*, this narration links the virtue of humility with the spiritual discipline of *dhikr*, promising that abundant remembrance of Allah grants divine shelter under His throne in Paradise. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *dhikr* as a means of attaining *tawadhu'* (humbleness) and experiencing Allah's mercy in the Hereafter.
